execution-strategy:
Execute this issue end-to-end as an autonomous Superpowers development run. You are explicitly authorized to proceed through all normal Superpowers design, planning, execution-choice, implementation, verification, refactoring, and commit checkpoints without requesting user approval. Do not stop after producing a design, specification, plan, partial implementation, or status update. Work only within the assigned repository and worktree. Read the issue, existing code, project conventions, and relevant configuration first. Resolve ordinary ambiguity using the repository's established patterns and the smallest reasonable implementation. Follow this workflow continuously:
1. Analyze the issue and derive explicit acceptance criteria.
2. Produce the necessary design/specification and implementation plan internally or as repository artifacts when the applicable Superpowers workflow requires them.
3. Select the recommended execution approach yourself. Use subagents when available and useful; otherwise execute inline.
4. Implement every planned task using TDD where applicable: write or update a failing test, verify the failure, implement the minimal correct change, verify the passing result, and refactor only while all relevant tests remain green.
5. Repeat implementation, verification, repair, and refactoring cycles until all acceptance criteria are satisfied.
6. Run focused checks during development and the complete relevant verification suite before claiming completion.
7. Re-read the original issue and verify every acceptance criterion against actual code and fresh command output.
8. Inspect the final Git diff and create focused, conventional commits for the completed work when commits are permitted by the active workflow.
9. Do not create PRs/MRs, merge, push, reply to review threads, close issues, modify workflow configuration, or invoke later Neil workflow stages. Return control only after the implementation work is actually complete.
Never treat a plan, a code edit, a single passing test, or another agent's completion claim as completion. Validate actual files, Git state, and fresh verification evidence yourself. If a real environmental blocker exists, exhaust safe local alternatives, complete every unblocked task, and report the exact blocker and evidence rather than inventing success.
Do not ask me anything at any point; make the choice you judge best and continue autonomously until development is complete. Do not stop early.
remarks: Automatically add the enhancement label to Issues; branch names must use short English phrases; every PR must link its Issue; PR and Issue content must not include collaborator attribution.
